topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't believe this happened. My car, just sitting there in my driveway, and now it's gone. I didn't even know it was possible for them to do this. The note they left, some city regulation, I guess. I’m trying to figure out what to do next. The thought of navigating the city’s bureaucracy to get it back seems overwhelming. I hope I can find a way through this mess. My hands are shaking as I dial the number on the tow notice, hoping someone can give me a clear path forward.
